lead.headline: Ultraviolette adds cruise control, Park Assist and a battery pyro fuse to the X-47 Venom
lead.text: Ultraviolette has announced three additions to the X-47 Venom electric motorcycle on its own YouTube channel. Cruise control now holds a set speed. Park Assist uses the integrated dual dashcam, with front and rear cameras and a 120 degree wide angle, to help when moving in reverse. And a Pyro Fuse, a battery safety device taken from four-wheelers, isolates the battery instantly during critical events.
lead.why: The X-47 Venom is the most searched bike in India this week, and cruise control is still rare on Indian electric motorcycles.

subs.headline: Norton will show a new 450cc roadster at EICMA, for India in 2027
subs.text: Norton, owned by TVS Motor Company, is moving into the middleweight segment with an all-new 450cc-class roadster. It makes its global debut at EICMA 2026 and is expected to launch in India in the second half of 2027, likely with a single-cylinder engine.

subs.headline: Bajaj Auto’s Q2 profit rises 35% as revenue crosses ₹20,000 crore for the first time
subs.text: Standalone revenue grew 34% to ₹20,003.43 crore, a record, and profit after tax rose 35% to ₹3,353.76 crore. Export volumes rose 41 percent and electric sales kept growing.

subs.headline: Bajaj warns entry-level motorcycle demand may weaken after the festive season
subs.text: Joint Managing Director Rakesh Sharma says drought, inflation and tighter rural lending could weigh on commuter motorcycles in Q4, while premium motorcycles and electric two-wheelers keep growing.

trends_summary.headline: Ultraviolette’s X-47 Venom leads bike searches at 20000+ as it gets cruise control
trends_summary.text: Honda’s black CB350C follows at 10000+ and Harley’s Sprint 440 at 5000+. Searches for Norton motorcycles rose 80% with news of a 450cc roadster for EICMA, and Bajaj’s adventure bike rose 90% as the name Trekker was reported.

trending.why: Ultraviolette added cruise control, Park Assist with front and rear cameras, and a battery pyro fuse to the X-47 Venom this week.
Honda launched a darker CB350C ahead of Diwali at around ₹2.32 lakh on-road; the name is not official yet.
A production-ready Sprint 440, the cruiser from the Harley-Davidson and Hero MotoCorp venture, was seen at a showroom without camouflage.
Norton, owned by TVS, will show an all-new 450cc roadster at EICMA 2026, with an India launch expected in 2027.
New spy shots show its console, likely the Pulsar N250’s, and a report gives its name as the Trekker.
